requirement_vague: Getting all todos returns only the current user's todos

implementation.location: GET /todos in list_todos; authentication in get_current_user; todo creation in create_todo
implementation.code_reference:
todos = session.exec(select(Todo).where(Todo.user_id == current_user.id)).all()
...
todo = Todo(
    title=todo_in.title,
    isComplete=todo_in.isComplete,
    user_id=current_user.id,
)
implementation.reasoning: The GET /todos endpoint filters todos by the authenticated user's id, so it returns only records owned by the current user. Todos are created with user_id=current_user.id, ensuring each todo is associated with its creator and preventing another user's todos from appearing in the list.
